(8) b) Briefly discuss the Government of India's initiatives aimed at improving the welfare and social security of Indian seafarers. How do these initiatives align with the MLC's requirements. (8)

notes: This sitting predates 15 March 2026, when the Merchant Shipping Act, 2025 commenced and repealed the Merchant Shipping Act, 1958 by s.324(1). Indian seafarer welfare provisions must be cited as they stood in September 2024. A 2026 object re-anchored onto the 2025 Act is a statute regression here and must be reversed, not inherited.
